rules: Do not ship raw 4K masters to every device.
Hero media is lazy-loaded after route readiness.
Pause or reduce animation when offscreen/backgrounded.
A missing hero asset must fall back without blocking route or HTML UI.
Keep hero media separate from business/data logic.
Reuse materials, lighting rigs and environment assets where practical.

tiers.Tier 2: optimized 3D/loop with constrained lighting and texture budgets
tiers.Tier 3: high-fidelity cinematic scene for capable desktop hardware
